title: 上部 凡尘问道 第3章 高烧中系统与倒计时上部 凡尘问道 第4章 弃玉佩险避天罗网
content_zh:
第1节寒热交加，规则系统醒
苍莽山脉的密林深处，凌无妄蜷缩在临时搭建的避风窝棚里，浑身滚烫得吓人，牙关打颤却又汗湿衣衫，整个人陷入半昏迷状态。
“无妄哥怎么会突然发烧？”凌小雨蹲在一旁，小手轻轻抚摸他的额头，满是担忧，“刚才破阵的时候还好好的，是不是用那个什么规则之眼伤了根基？”
苏晚晴一边用湿布擦拭凌无妄的脸颊降温，一边皱眉分析“应该是强行催动破法能力的代价。破法者的能力逆天，以他无灵根、经脉尽断的体质强行使用，心神和魂魄都会受损。”
凌母将最后一点干粮碾碎，试图喂到凌无妄嘴边，却被他无意识地推开。“这可怎么办？前有天道钱庄的追兵，后有他这不知名的病症，我们连疗伤的丹药都没有。”
三人刚从李默的追杀中逃脱，不敢停留，只能在密林深处短暂休整。此时夜色渐深，雪越下越大，窝棚外寒风呼啸，夹杂着远处隐约的妖兽嘶吼，处境愈发艰难。
凌无妄的意识陷入混沌，眼前不断闪过破碎的画面金色的宫殿悬浮在云端，无数符文如星河般流转，一道身着金袍的模糊身影背对着他，声音威严而悲伤“无妄，天道已乱，闭源规则横行，唯有你能以开源破局……”
“是谁？”凌无妄想开口询问，却发不出任何声音。
画面突然扭曲，变成漫天血色，无数修士嘶吼着倒下，金袍身影被黑色符文缠绕，声音变得嘶哑“记住，玉佩藏着记忆，三千道院有真相……”
“啊！”
凌无妄猛地抽搐了一下，双眼紧闭，额头青筋暴起。就在这时，他的脑海中突然响起一道冰冷的机械音，与之前任何声音都不同
【检测到宿主意识波动，符合激活条件……天道纠错系统启动中……】
苏晚晴三人被他的动静吓了一跳，只见凌无妄周身突然泛起淡淡的金色光晕，与他怀中的玉佩遥相呼应，光晕所及之处，周围的雪花都停滞了片刻。
【系统激活成功！正在扫描当前世界规则……】
【扫描结果世界规则污染度99%，闭源规则占据主导，原初天道符文残缺，灵气循环紊乱……】
凌无妄的意识被这道机械音拉回一丝清明，他能清晰地“看到”一个半透明的蓝色面板出现在脑海中，上面跳动着一行行金色文字。
【宿主凌无妄】
【身份前天道第七执笔者（堕凡状态）】
【体质无灵根（神格碎片封印中）】
【能力规则之眼（初级）——可解析闭源规则漏洞，当前使用代价寿元消耗、心神受损】

【当前任务12时辰内潜入三千道院杂役处，获取临时庇护所】
【任务失败惩罚天道钱庄清除者全力追杀，存活率低于1%】
“系统？天道纠错系统？”凌无妄心中震撼，这突如其来的变化，让他对自己的身份有了更模糊的认知。
【检测到宿主疑问，补充说明本系统由原初天道残留力量凝聚而成，唯一使命为辅助宿主纠正被篡改的天道规则，恢复开源秩序】
就在这时，系统面板突然弹出一道红色警告，冰冷的机械音再次响起
【警告！检测到玉佩共鸣反应，天道钱庄追踪符咒已锁定玉佩能量波动，追踪信号将于10分钟后精准定位宿主位置！】
第2节十分钟限，玉佩成死穴
“什么？！”凌无妄心中一惊，强行想要睁开眼睛，却只觉得眼皮重如千斤。
系统的警告如同惊雷，让他瞬间明白，怀中的玉佩既是关键信物，也是玉佩既是关键信物，也是此刻最大的催命符。
【追踪符咒原理采用高阶闭源符文，通过玉佩残留的神格能量锁定目标，信号穿透性极强，常规隐匿手段无效】
【解决方案1销毁玉佩——优点彻底切断追踪；缺点丢失记忆备份，后续解锁身份、修复神格难度提升90%】
【解决方案2剥离玉佩能量——优点保留玉佩本体；缺点需消耗大量原初灵气，当前条件不具备】
【解决方案3转移追踪目标——优点暂时规避风险；缺点玉佩可能被天道钱庄获取，引发更大危机】
凌无妄快速分析着三个方案，销毁玉佩绝对不行，那是找回记忆的关键；剥离能量更是无从谈起，他们现在连最低阶的灵气都无法稳定获取；只剩下转移追踪目标这一条路可走。
“晚晴！”凌无妄用尽全力，终于发出了微弱的声音。
苏晚晴立刻凑上前“我在！你怎么样？能说话了？”
“玉佩……”凌无妄艰难地抬起手，指向自己的胸口，“天道钱庄的追踪符……锁定了它，10分钟后……就能找到我们。”
苏晚晴和凌母脸色骤变，他们都清楚，一旦被天道钱庄的清除者精准定位，以他们目前的实力，根本没有任何反抗之力。
“那我们现在就走！继续往三千道院方向跑！”凌母急道，就要扶凌无妄起身。
“没用的！”凌无妄摇摇头，气息微弱，“追踪符的信号……速度比我们快，跑不掉的。”

苏晚晴皱眉“那怎么办？难道真要把玉佩扔了？这可是你找回身份的关键！”
content_en:
Section 1: Cold and hot, the rules system wakes up
Deep in the dense forest of the vast mountains, Ling Wuwang huddled in a makeshift shelter from the wind. His whole body was frighteningly hot, his teeth were chattering but his clothes were soaked with sweat, and he fell into a semi-conscious state.
"Why did Brother Wuwang suddenly have a fever?" Ling Xiaoyu squatted aside and gently touched his forehead with her small hand, full of worry, "It was fine when I broke the formation just now. Did I use that Eye of Rules to damage the foundation?"
Su Wanqing wiped Ling Wuwang's cheek with a wet cloth to cool down, while frowning and analyzing, "It should be the price of forcibly activating the spell-breaking ability. The spell-breaker's ability is incredible, and if he uses it forcefully with his physique with no spiritual roots and severed meridians, his mind and soul will be damaged."
Ling's mother crushed up the last bit of dry food and tried to feed it to Ling Wuwang's mouth, but he pushed it away unconsciously. "What can we do? There are the pursuers of Tiandao Bank in the front, and he has an unknown illness in the back. We don't even have the elixir to heal the injury."
The three of them had just escaped from Li Mo's pursuit and did not dare to stay. They could only rest briefly deep in the dense forest. At this time, the night was getting darker, the snow was falling heavier and heavier, and the cold wind was howling outside the shack, mixed with the faint roar of monsters in the distance, making the situation more and more difficult.
Ling Wuwang's consciousness fell into chaos, and broken images flashed before his eyes. The golden palace was suspended in the clouds, and countless runes were flowing like a galaxy. A vague figure in a golden robe turned its back to him, with a majestic and sad voice: "Wuwang, the way of heaven is in chaos, and closed-source rules are rampant. Only you can break the situation with open source..."
"Who is it?" Ling Wuwan wanted to ask, but no sound came out.
The picture suddenly distorted and turned into a sky full of blood. Countless monks screamed and fell down. The golden-robed figure was entangled with black runes, and the voice became hoarse. "Remember, the jade pendant hides memories, and there is the truth in the Three Thousand Taoist Temple..."
"Ah!"
Ling Wuwang twitched violently, his eyes were closed tightly, and veins popped out on his forehead. At this moment, a cold mechanical sound suddenly sounded in his mind, which was different from any sound before.
[Fluctuations in host consciousness have been detected, and the conditions for activation are met... The Tiandao error correction system is starting...]
Su Wanqing and the other three were startled by his movement, and saw a faint golden halo suddenly appear around Ling Wuwang, echoing the jade pendant in his arms. Wherever the halo touched, the surrounding snowflakes stopped for a moment.
[System activation successful! Scanning the current world rules...]
[The scan results show that the world rules pollution degree is 99%, closed-source rules dominate, the original heavenly runes are incomplete, and the spiritual energy circulation is disordered...]
Ling Wuwang's consciousness was brought back to clarity by this mechanical sound. He could clearly "see" a translucent blue panel appearing in his mind, with lines of golden text dancing on it.
[Host Ling Wuwang]
[Identity: Former Seventh Writer of Heaven (Falled to Mortal State)]
[Physique has no spiritual roots (the fragments of the divine head are being sealed)]
[Eye of Ability Rules (Elementary) - Can analyze loopholes in closed source rules, current use costs lifespan and mental damage]
[The current mission is to sneak into the Miscellaneous Office of Sanqian Taoist Temple within 12 hours and obtain temporary shelter]
[Mission failure punishes the Tiandao Bank purgers to pursue them with all their strength, and the survival rate is less than 1%]
"System? Tiandao error correction system?" Ling Wuwang was shocked. This sudden change gave him a vaguer understanding of his identity.
[The host's doubts are detected, and it is added that this system is condensed from the remaining power of the original Heavenly Dao. Its only mission is to assist the host in correcting the tampered Heavenly Dao rules and restoring open source order]
At this moment, a red warning suddenly popped up on the system panel, and the cold mechanical sound sounded again.
【Warning! The resonance reaction of the jade pendant has been detected, and the Tiandao Bank's tracking spell has locked onto the energy fluctuations of the jade pendant. The tracking signal will accurately locate the host's location in 10 minutes! 】
The ten-minute limit of the second quarter, the jade pendant becomes a fatal weakness
"What?!" Ling Wuwang was shocked and tried to open his eyes.When I opened my eyes, I felt that my eyelids were as heavy as a thousand pounds.
The system's warning was like thunder, making him instantly understand that the jade pendant in his arms was not only a key token, but also the biggest reminder at the moment.
[The principle of the tracking charm uses high-level closed-source runes to lock the target through the remaining divine energy of the jade pendant. The signal is extremely penetrating and conventional concealment methods are ineffective]
[Solution 1: Destroy the jade pendant - the advantage is to completely cut off tracking; the disadvantage is that the memory backup is lost, and the subsequent difficulty of unlocking the identity and restoring the godhood increases by 90%]
[Solution 2: Strip off the energy of the jade pendant - the advantages are to retain the body of the jade pendant; the disadvantage is that it requires a large amount of original spiritual energy, which is not met by the current conditions]
[Solution 3: Transfer the tracking target - the advantage is to temporarily avoid risks; the disadvantage is that the jade pendant may be obtained by Tiandao Bank, causing a greater crisis]
Ling Wuwang quickly analyzed the three options. It was absolutely impossible to destroy the jade pendant, which was the key to retrieving the memory. It was impossible to strip the energy. They could not even obtain the lowest level of spiritual energy stably. The only way left was to transfer and track the target.
"Wan Qing!" Ling Wuwu tried his best and finally made a weak voice.
Su Wanqing immediately came forward, "I'm here! How are you? Can you speak?"
"Jade pendant..." Ling Wuwang raised his hand with difficulty and pointed at his chest, "Tiandao Bank's tracking talisman... locked on it, and will find us in 10 minutes..."
Su Wanqing and Ling Mu's expressions changed suddenly. They both knew that once they were pinpointed by the Tiandao Bank's purgers, with their current strength, they would have no power to resist.
"Then let's leave now! Keep running towards Sanqian Taoist Temple!" Ling's mother said urgently, trying to help Ling Wuwang get up.
"It's useless!" Ling Wuwang shook his head, his breath weak, "The signal of the tracking talisman... is faster than us, so we can't escape."
Su Wanqing frowned, "What should we do? Do we really want to throw away the jade pendant? This is the key to regaining your identity!"
